Subject: Nova Analytics discovery — Q2 timing & approval

Thanks again for taking time today — really useful conversation. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we're aligned:

- Need: reduce per-token inference cost for high-throughput batch summaries and maintain 150ms p95 latency for the interactive analytics UI.
- Current constraints: on-prem procurement process + security questions (SOC2, VPC) and procurement window closing at end of Q2.
- Redwood fit: Dedicated or Private deployment can meet the isolation and latency requirements; we discussed quantized model variants for cost savings and our routing/fallback policies for reliability.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll put together a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones for procurement, security review, and a pilot (2–4 weeks).
2) Can you confirm who will own procurement and whether there's a pre-approved budget line for inference this quarter? That will drive whether we should aim to start a pilot before EoQ.
3) If it's helpful, I can loop in our Solutions Engineer to do a short bake-off plan for model/latency verification.

Goal: understand whether budget/approval timing still makes this a Q2 priority for Nova. If so, I'll share a compact MAP + a pricing ballpark by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — look forward to next steps.

—
